title: Decide where the Space Manage panel's Web editor link goes: the website builder, or the Space page sidebar it opens today

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: SCAN-971 (#3493) added a 'Web editor' quick link to /spaces/<slug>/edit-page. Since #3471 that route sends Home to /spaces/<slug>?edit=page, the Space page's sidebar, so the link never reaches the website editor, which is only reachable through siteAdminHandoffPath(slug, 'editor') (/manage/leadership/open?to=editor) and which the site's own chrome calls Website builder (#3491). The owner asked for links to the website and the web editor. Ruling: add a Website builder door at siteAdminHandoffPath(slug, 'editor') beside the page editor, or point Web editor there (keep /edit-page if SCAN-971's probe must hold).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/spaces/manage-quick-links.tsx','utf8');if(!/siteAdminHandoffPath\\(/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-1015: the Manage panel has no door to the website builder; Web editor opens the Space page sidebar');process.exit(1)}"
